workerResult.summary: Foghorn Funeral — a cyberpunk mourning ritual for lost ships. Three-drone Web Audio mixer (HULL/SWELL/THRENODY) whose levels drive a layered fog canvas with a bobbing, sinking ship; a serif eulogy typer with word counter and a full 'submersion' sequence (auto-type, horn, sink, REST IN THE DEEP). Fully keyboard-operable (SPACE/H horn, 1-3 faders, M mute, T eulogy, E commit, R revive, ESC release) plus native tab/arrow support. localStorage persists mix and eulogy. Verified at 375px with no console errors or horizontal overflow.
